prior_code_control.expected_failure: The prior whole-file implementation requests read(-1), violating the test's positive read bound.

coverage: Identity hashing requests at most 1 MiB per read and retains the expected digest
Node shutdown and final resource sample precede identity verification
A surviving worker, raised final-sample error or recorded sample read error prevents hashing
Configuration, binary and catalog mutations remain failures after sampling ends
Missing input files fail independently without overwriting an earlier process failure
Existing sample-gap, metrics, cleanup, exact-result and matched-profile gates remain enforced

measurement_boundary: The final resource snapshot is taken after node/worker shutdown and before post-run identity verification. Post-run hashing is excluded from reported active/shutdown counters, peaks and sampling gaps; startup setup remains included in whole-cgroup counters. Old-observer reports must not be pooled with new-observer pairs.
scope: Observer/client/reconciler unit controls; no source database, query workload or capacity campaign was started. Ordering uses controlled process/sample fixtures. This does not establish successful micro-VM capacity or explain every part of the earlier sampling gaps.
